facility.name: Dao Thi Tran
facility.days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: The operation does not have liability insurance and failed to provide written notification to the parent of each child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

Required Admission Information - Parents' Information: It was noted that the parent's information section was still blank in one child's record.   Note: The caregiver contacted the parents to obtain this information and updated the admission form accordingly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Information (26 TAC §747.605(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: It was noticed that one child's record did not have the date of admission.   Note: The caregiver entered the admission date into the record during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: It was noted that the Emergency Contact information section was blank in two children's records. Note:  The caregiver called the parents to obtain this information and updated the admission form accordingly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: The school s name and phone number were not available in two  school-aged children's record.  Note: The caregiver called the parents to obtain this information and placed it on the admission forms during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §747.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Two childen records did not indicate if the child did or did not have any special needs.   Note: The caregiver called the parents to obtain this information and placed it on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §747.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver's annual training record was not available for review for the period from 01/10/2021-01/10/2022 during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: The date of admission was not available in one child s record.   NOTE:  The date of admission was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))
